body.x: South Korean digital olfactory solutions company Deepscent Inc. announced that its flagship Deepscent AI platform has been submitted to the CES 2026 Innovation Awards in four categories: Home Appliances, Smart Home, Smart Communities, and Content & Entertainment. The platform leverages multimodal AI to autonomously generate custom scent blends by interpreting images, music, moods, and contextual inputs—without requiring user expertise.

Deepscent AI’s multimodal algorithm can analyze environmental and emotional cues in just three seconds to deliver optimal fragrance profiles. The system is trained on more than 100,000 fragrance metadata points, covering accords, notes, and reviews, enabling precise and context-aware blending. Its dynamic system uses 20 biodegradable capsules with three intensity levels, producing up to 392,445 unique scent combinations. The capsules automatically calibrate based on temperature, humidity, and airflow, while the diffuser covers up to 50m² with ultra-quiet performance under 30dB.

Designed with sustainability in mind, Deepscent AI is built with recyclable ABS-aluminum composites and 100% biodegradable capsules. It also supports MQTT and RESTful APIs for seamless IoT integration, making it suitable for both personal and shared environments.

To date, the company has secured six granted patents and 21 pending applications across hardware, algorithms, and system integration—fortifying its intellectual property in the field of AI-powered olfactory computing.

The platform’s potential impact spans multiple sectors. In Home Appliances, it enhances living spaces with adaptive scent personalization. For Smart Homes, it creates mood-driven atmospheres that respond to user context. Within Smart Communities, it can scale to public spaces, enhancing collective well-being and identity. In Content & Entertainment, it synchronizes with digital media to enable multisensory storytelling.
“By embedding scent into spatial computing, Deepscent AI establishes a new benchmark for immersive, emotion-driven innovation,” said Marco Kwon(권일봉), CEO of Deepscent.
CES 2026 will take place in Las Vegas from January 6 to 9, where Innovation Award winners will be officially announced.
